observations.cause: The local wrapper attempted to scrub inherited GIT_* variables with Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(name, null, Process). On this PowerShell host that left GIT_PAGER present with an empty value, and the Explorer correctly rejected the inherited Git environment.
observations.correction: Remove inherited GIT_* entries from the process environment provider before the next exact gate invocation. No product or test behavior is weakened for this observation.

observations.cause: The governance test required the obsolete top-level action token anchore/sbom-action@ after V4 intentionally replaced the false-green generator invocation with the pinned download-syft sub-action and explicit fail-closed Syft execution.
observations.correction: Require anchore/sbom-action/download-syft@. The dedicated CI contract test continues to require explicit SBOM generation, semantic validation, exact upload paths, and exact attestation subjects.

raw_log.content_policy: Exact PowerShell redirection output from the failed attempt; retained without line-ending normalization or text diff.

nonclaims: This failed pre-candidate attempt is not evidence that the V4 candidate passed the full local gate.
The two Explorer errors do not justify relaxing inherited Git-environment rejection.
The governance assertion correction does not establish that the SBOM exists in remote CI; the exact candidate artifact and attestation must still be observed after push.
rollback: Revert the governance assertion correction only together with a replacement test that recognizes the explicit pinned Syft path without permitting the unsupported false-green action interface. Preserve this adverse receipt and raw log.
